tools.name: start_run
tools.description: Acquire or renew the run lease and page through eligible work. Persisted attempts survive restarts; analysis cooldowns do not block discovery.

tools.name: get_runtime
tools.description: Read this installation's cloud runtime for acquisition and speech transcription. Prefer file=manifest: its archive contains six files and an offline hash-verifying materializer. Never regenerate the lockfile. Call start_run first on a new installation.

tools.name: register_sources
tools.description: Register source identities and fill a missing creator from verified source metadata. Preserve existing creators, content, manual edits, and removed references.

tools.name: store_cover
tools.description: Store original Instagram cover bytes after validation and a conditional revision check.

tools.name: update_reference
tools.description: Persist backend-only caption, original and Portuguese speech, visual text, semantic description, and classification. Legacy analysis remains supported.

transcription_pt.description: Use translated for a Portuguese translation, original for unchanged Portuguese speech, absent for verified silence, or unavailable for missing text.

semantic_description.description: Use generated for a grounded model synthesis, or unavailable with null when no description can be produced.

transcription_pt.description: Brazilian Portuguese translation of the original speech. Copy the original text when all speech is already Portuguese.

semantic_description.description: Concise Brazilian Portuguese synthesis of the subject, context, purpose, and concepts supported by the caption, transcript, and visual inspection. Generated by the Work model.

tools.name: get_reference
tools.description: Read persisted source metadata and the owner reference receipt; internal content requires explicit selection.

tools.name: finish_run
tools.description: Persist checkpoints and cooldowns, calculate run counts, and release the lease.

tools.name: sync_collections
tools.description: Map observed Instagram collection IDs to stable Site IDs. Preserve existing labels, references, and collections absent from this page.

tools.name: set_import_scope
tools.description: Apply the owner-selected future discovery scope. Keep existing references and discovery checkpoints.

tools.name: get_discovery
tools.description: Read one durable browser discovery checkpoint without acquiring a run lease.

tools.name: record_discovery_page
tools.description: Atomically register confirmed Reels and save the last observed card of one browser page. Reuse request_id on response loss.

tools.name: set_import_mode
tools.description: Choose existing or new-only import before the first discovery write. New-only activates after all required initial lists complete.
